## Recipe checklist

- [ ] My recipe follows the format shown in the README (frontmatter + method).
- [ ] The filename is kebab-case and unique, e.g. `hildas-chicken-curry.md`.
- [ ] `country` is a 2-letter ISO code (e.g. `IN`, not `india`).
